title: MG-04 re-judgment: prior vs learned candidates (MaMe-Re, frozen v2.2 conditions, both pair modes per test context)

conditions.split: v2.1 frozen 30 train / 20 validation / 200 test contexts (data/mame_fixed_context_splits_v21.json), UNMODIFIED from v2.1
conditions.training_data: 30 v2.1 train contexts only (CC BY 4.0 columns); no test/validation labels used for fitting; alpha selected on v2.1 validation only
conditions.validation_construction: both pair modes per validation context (20 contexts x 2 modes = 40 cases), identical to v2.1
conditions.test_construction: BOTH pair modes per test context (200 contexts x 2 modes = 400 cases) via the identical build_cases_both_modes used for the v2.1 validation pool; cases are two observations of 200 contexts, not 400 independent cases
conditions.comparability: v2.2 numbers are a NEW version and are NOT same-condition comparisons with v2.0/v2.1 numbers (test construction differs); within v2.2 all arms face identical cases and scoring
conditions.gate_definition: an arm beats prior iff strict_accuracy is strictly greater than prior's AND mean_regret is <= prior's (pre-registration section 4)

control_v21_reproduction.split: v2.1 frozen 30 train / 20 validation / 200 test contexts (data/mame_fixed_context_splits_v21.json)
